Why Regular Dental Check-ups Are Important | Dentist in Mulund East
Many people remember to service their car, maintain appliances, and upgrade their phones regularly. But dental check-ups are often ignored until pain starts. At Dr Prashant’s Dental Care Clinic in Mulund East, Mumbai, we emphasize that good oral health is essential for your overall body health.

Your mouth is the gateway to your body. Poor oral hygiene can lead to problems such as tooth decay, gum disease, bad breath, and infections. Studies show that gum disease may be linked to problems like heart conditions, diabetes, lung infections, pregnancy complications, and increased risk of stroke.

Regular dental check-ups help detect problems early and prevent complicated treatments later. Professional teeth cleaning removes plaque and tartar that brushing alone cannot remove. Visiting a dentist in Mulund East every 6 months helps maintain healthy teeth, strong gums, and a confident smile.

Warning signs such as bleeding gums, tooth pain, sensitivity, bad breath, or difficulty chewing should never be ignored. Early treatment can prevent major dental procedures.

Why Do Gaps Between Teeth Increase With Age? 🦷

Have you noticed new gaps forming between your teeth as you get older? Increasing spaces between teeth are common with age, but they can sometimes indicate underlying dental problems that should not be ignored.

The most common causes include:

🦷 Gum Disease (Periodontitis) – Infection of the gums damages the supporting bone, causing teeth to shift and create gaps.

🦷 Bone Loss Around Teeth – As the bone supporting your teeth weakens, teeth may start moving apart.

🦷 Missing Teeth – When a tooth is lost and not replaced, neighboring teeth slowly drift into the empty space.

🦷 Gum Recession – Receding gums reduce support around teeth and may lead to visible spacing.

🦷 Teeth Grinding (Bruxism) – Constant pressure from grinding can cause teeth to move over time.

If you notice increasing gaps between teeth, it may be an early sign of gum disease or bone loss. Early dental treatment can prevent further complications and protect your smile.
